footer.disclaimer: Independent prototype. Not a bank or government service.
footer.tagline: Made for the moments that matter.
guided.choose: Choose what happened. Opening a link does not mean a report was made.
guided.form_intro: Use the actual reporting time. A busy line or an unanswered call is an attempt, not a completed report. Leave the reference blank if it has not arrived.
guided.intent.later: Reporting promptly matters. Choose a time that works for you; this is your reminder, not a legal deadline.
guided.intent.no_answer: No answer from the {channel} does not complete the report. You can try another reporting channel while waiting.
guided.intent.waiting: A reply may take time. Keep your complaint reference; choose when you want to check again.
guided.label: Guided next action
guided.no_answer: I tried, but got no answer
guided.reference_pending: Reference: pending. Add it here when it arrives.
guided.title: How did this step go?
help.keep_text: Preserve screenshots and messages. This prototype does not store uploaded images or include them in exports.
help.missing_text: Leave optional fields empty and add the information directly when reporting.
help.never: Never enter an OTP, PIN, password or full account number.
help.text: A transaction reference and a short description help make your reports consistent.
help.title: Just the details that matter.
home.action_bank: Report through your bank’s official channel immediately. Ask for a complaint reference.
home.action_helpline: Use the national financial cyber-fraud helpline. Keep the acknowledgement you receive.
home.action_portal: Prepare your incident description for cybercrime.gov.in and record your reference.
home.actions_title: You don’t have to figure it all out at once.
home.already: Already reported? You can still use Reclaim to organise the facts and save your references. Recovery is never guaranteed.
home.description: Tell us what happened. We’ll prepare what you need to say, then help you keep track of your reports.
home.preview_local: Your details stay on this demo machine.
home.preview_step2_sub: The right details, ready to share
home.preview_title: A little clarity. A lot less uncertainty.

urgent.text: Stop further payments. Call 1930 and contact your bank through its official app or website.
urgent.title: Lost money? Act now. The paperwork can wait.
why.conflict: Your bank, 1930 and the portal should all receive the same details.
why.enter: A payment needs an amount and a time before it can be added.
why.fill: Adding it now saves typing it again in every report.
why.placement: So every payment you lost is included once, and nothing unrelated is added.
why.possible_duplicate: So the same payment is not counted twice.
why.unreadable: A reference helps the bank find the payment. It is optional.
